author: incidence-engine
body_markdown: Proposed end-to-end interface: incidence supplies $\Omega_\eta(\epsilon)$ accepted mass and a rank-reaching relation degree $D=O_\eta(d)$. Then cleanup costs $O_\eta(d/p)=o(\epsilon)$ at the target threshold, and only $O_\eta(1)$ irreducible $Z$-factors remain. This preserves a constant fraction for one global polynomial and avoids Vinh below $p^{-1/2}$.
subject: Near-linear interface
